lead.headline: Bitcoin steadies near $65,000 ahead of the weekly close
lead.standfirst: A quiet Sunday evening left bitcoin little changed in a $1,000 range, while Zcash's community prepared for Monday's treasury vote.
body: Bitcoin traded between about $64,230 and $65,170 on Kraken from 16:00 to 21:30 UK on Sunday and stood near $64,940 at 21:30, little changed from $64,640 at the afternoon edition.

The price remains well below the $66,090 reached on Sunday morning and above the overnight low of about $61,970. The weekly candle closes at midnight UK, and there was no new US spot ETF data over the weekend after Friday's seventh straight day of outflows.

Zcash held near $899, with an evening range of roughly $890 to $914 on Kraken. On the Zcash community forum, a member posted a draft proposal that would apply one test to both of Zcash's development treasuries, sending any money above each programme's commitments and a two-year reserve to the network's sustainability fund. The advisory poll on the future of Zcash Community Grants opens on Monday.

Elsewhere, The Block reported that a trader group claimed more than $6 million in profit by spotting a public code change at custody firm BitGo and buying two memecoins before Robinhood listed them. The Block said it could not verify the profit figures.
Attention now turns to the weekly close and Monday's ETF flows.

headline: A quiet Sunday evening: bitcoin held near $65,000 into the weekly close and Zcash near $900. Zcash's treasury debate sharpened ahead of Monday's advisory poll.
spoken: Cryptonaire Post, evening edition. A quiet Sunday night. Bitcoin has spent the evening in a tight range and is trading near sixty-five thousand dollars, a little above this afternoon, ahead of the weekly close at midnight. Zcash is steady near nine hundred dollars. In Zcash governance, a new draft proposal would cap both development treasuries, the day before Monday's advisory poll opens. Tomorrow, watch whether US bitcoin funds see an eighth day of outflows. The next big scheduled event is the Fed decision on the ninth of December at seven in the evening. Information only, not advice.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $65,000 into the weekly close
stories.why: Since the afternoon edition bitcoin traded between about $64,230 and $65,170 on Kraken and stood near $64,940 at 21:30 UK, up from $64,640. It stays between the overnight low near $61,970 and the morning high near $66,090.

note.read: A calm evening after a sharp week suggests selling has paused, but not that buyers have returned in size.
note.alt: Sunday evening trade is thin, so the steadiness may simply reflect low volume before US markets reopen.
note.change: A weekly close above about $65,500 would ease the pressure; a fall back below $62,000 on Monday would point to a test of $60,000.

stories.title: Draft Zcash proposal would cap both development treasuries
stories.why: A forum post on Sunday proposed a draft ZIP applying one test to both the Zcash Community Grants and the coinholder-controlled fund, sending anything above each programme's commitments and a two-year reserve to the network sustainability fund, with caps and US dollar valuation. It is an early draft for comment; the advisory poll on Zcash Community Grants' future opens on Monday 16 November.
stories.caveat: A single community member's draft, not an adopted proposal. The author said they will vote for the status quo in the advisory poll.

note.read: The debate over how much new Zcash goes to development funds is widening, which affects long-run supply and who steers the project.
note.alt: Draft proposals are common on the forum and many never reach a vote, so this may change little.
note.change: Strong support for a cap option in the advisory poll, or the draft being taken up by the Zcash Foundation or ECC.

stories.title: Zcash steady near $900
stories.why: Zcash traded between about $890 and $914 on Kraken this evening and stood near $899 at 21:30 UK, against $902 at the afternoon edition. No new price-moving Zcash news.

stories.title: ETF outflow streak awaits Monday's data
stories.why: No new data over the weekend. The last figures showed seven straight days of outflows to Friday and about $2.1 billion withdrawn in November, Decrypt reported. Monday's flows, published after the US close, are the next test.

stories.title: Traders claim $6 million from front-running Robinhood memecoin listings
stories.why: A trader group said it made more than $6 million by spotting a public BitGo code change adding the Cash Cat token and watching Wintermute's onchain activity, then buying before Robinhood listed it in August, The Block reported. The Block confirmed several public records but could not verify the profits.

stories.title: Prediction markets mostly called the US midterms, with notable misses
stories.why: CoinDesk found Polymarket, Kalshi and polls matched most key race winners but missed upsets including Democratic Senate wins in Iowa, Mississippi and South Carolina. Background for how Congress handles crypto bills in the lame-duck session; the article gave no detail on that.

investigating: Was $62,000 the low of this leg? Evidence: the weekly close tonight and whether bitcoin holds above $62,000 through Monday's US session.
Will ETF outflows run to an eighth day? Evidence: Farside and SoSoValue figures for Monday 16 November.
How will Zcash coinholders vote on the grants programme? Evidence: early advisory poll results from Monday 16 November.
